answer_1.quote: In this paper, we propose the sequence-oblivious generation (SOG) method for tag recommendation... The tag generation process is sequence-oblivious, not following the way natural language sentence is generated.

answer_2.quote: We evaluate with precision-at-k (P@K) and recall-at-k (R@K), with K being 1, 3 and 5. Both are widely used for recommendation tasks...
